entities.name: Brewster H. Shaw

entities.summary: Brewster Hopkinson Shaw Jr. is a retired NASA astronaut, colonel of the U.S. Air Force, and former Boeing executive. Shaw was inducted into the U.S. Astronaut Hall of Fame on May 6, 2006.
